_readme: Optional. Everything here is OPTIONAL — the hub works with this file empty.
Keys are game slugs (see data/games.json for the slug scan.mjs gave each game).
Anything you put here WINS over what was scraped from the game's HTML.
Any field you add that has values somewhere in the library automatically grows
its own filter rail on the wall. Add nothing and no rails appear. Example:
"restricted": true keeps a game in the repo and in the catalogue but off the
wall. It appears only when dev settings (Shift + F2, PIN) switch on
"Show all content". "hidden": true removes a game from the catalogue entirely.
